sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Cocos (Keeling) Islands Applied Laws Ordinance 1992 (compilation of 13 June 2026), Schedule: Public and Bank Holidays Act 1972 (W.A.)(C.K.I.)
sources.said: Second Schedule — Public Holidays and Bank Holidays 1. New Year’s Day (1 January) 2. Australia Day (26 January) 3. The Muslim festival day known as Hari Raya Puasa (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 4. Act of Self‑Determination day (6 April) (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 5. Good Friday 6. Easter Monday 7. Anzac Day (25 April) 8. The Muslim festival day known as Hari Raya Haji (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 9. The Muslim festival day known as Hari Maulad Nabi (Prophet Mohammad’s Birthday) (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 10. Celebration Day for the Anniversary of the Birthday of the Reigning Sovereign (6 June) (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 11. Christmas Day (25 December) 12. Boxing Day (26 December) 13. If a day referred to in item 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9 or 11 falls on a Saturday or Sunday—the immediately following Monday 14. If the day referred to in item 12 falls on a Saturday—the immediately following Monday 15. If the day referred to in item 12 falls on a Sunday or Monday—the immediately following Tuesday
sources.note: The compilation's text, saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/cc-alo.txt (from its document_1.html). It replaces the applied Western Australian Act's Schedule for the Territory.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Notice – Proclamation – Special Public & Bank Holidays 2026, Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, No 02/2025 (11 September 2025)
sources.said: Act of Self Determination Day Tuesday, 7 April 2026 (in lieu of Monday, 6 April 2026) Hari Raya Puasa Friday, 20 March 2026* Hari Raya Haji Wednesday, 27 May 2026* King’s Birthday Monday, 8 June 2026 Hari Maulaud Nabi Wednesday, 26 August 2026*
sources.note: The Administrator's proclamation, saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/frl-F2025N00751-doc.html; the community bulletin A21/2025 doesn't answer from here.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Notice – Proclamation – Special Public & Bank Holidays 2027, Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, No 02/2026 (24 July 2026)
sources.said: Act of Self Determination Day Tuesday, 6 April 2027 Hari Raya Puasa Tuesday, 9 March 2027* Hari Raya Haji Monday, 17 May 2027* King’s Birthday Monday, 7 June 2027 Hari Maulaud Nabi Monday, 16 August 2027* (in lieu of Sunday 15 August 2027*)
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/frl-F2026N00561-doc.html. Good Friday and Easter Monday aren't moved. Readings: a day appointed by proclamation is kept on the day the proclamation gives, not moved again; Christmas Day moved to a Monday keeps that Monday even when it is Boxing Day's, which then goes to the Tuesday (items 13 and 15). The Islamic days are as proclaimed, which the proclamations say may move by a day or two with the moon; a later change wasn't looked for. From 2028 only the Schedule's fixed days are kept (announced to 2027). The lists are the rules' days for 2026 and 2027, which give each proclamation's days.
